sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Lady S. took care of Metz after he was put under a terrible curse due to his disturbing the Ring of Behemoth. [Ladies' Choice] She later broke her loyalty to Metz, warning Dante that Guggenheim was coming to give him a lecture on Metz' behalf, though she did so in good faith. [The Divine Comedy]

After Metz's curse was broken, her station was changed. She later escorted Rassimov after he was arrested in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt. [Rassimov's Secret]

When the Huntik Foundation allied with the Casterwill family to fight the Betrayer and his Blood Spirals, Lady S. was in a Scramjet next to Metz. During the fighting, she acted as a field medic, healing Lucas Casterwill and his team. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Lady S. was a caring nurse for Metz. However, she thought the curse left him too delusional and that it would have been dangerous to believe his every word and to do what he asked. {{source|Ladies' Choice}} She knows [[Dante Vale]] well, as he often visited Metz while he was bedridden. Though she is not known to use offensive spells, she is a cool and level-headed woman who remains concentrated and focused on her job as a nurse even while on the battlefield. {{source|Dante's Return}}

full_text:
Lady S. is a nurse who works as a part of the Huntik Foundation. For a period of time, she worked as Metz's nurse and was responsible for looking after him in Metz's country estate in Germany. Following his recovery, she became an active field agent and joined the fight against the Blood Spirals.

History

Lady S. took care of Metz after he was put under a terrible curse due to his disturbing the Ring of Behemoth. [Ladies' Choice] She later broke her loyalty to Metz, warning Dante that Guggenheim was coming to give him a lecture on Metz' behalf, though she did so in good faith. [The Divine Comedy]

After Metz's curse was broken, her station was changed. She later escorted Rassimov after he was arrested in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt. [Rassimov's Secret]

When the Huntik Foundation allied with the Casterwill family to fight the Betrayer and his Blood Spirals, Lady S. was in a Scramjet next to Metz. During the fighting, she acted as a field medic, healing Lucas Casterwill and his team. [Dante's Return]

Personality

Lady S. was a caring nurse for Metz. However, she thought the curse left him too delusional and that it would have been dangerous to believe his every word and to do what he asked. [Ladies' Choice] She knows Dante Vale well, as he often visited Metz while he was bedridden. Though she is not known to use offensive spells, she is a cool and level-headed woman who remains concentrated and focused on her job as a nurse even while on the battlefield. [Dante's Return]

Abilities

Lady S. is a professional nurse and knows how to treat her patients. As a Seeker, she utilizes spells focused on healing wounds and injuries.

Spells Utilized

• Everheal
